title: key_generate error path skips inbuf_clear; sensitive IKM lingers
description: Trigger: user writes key bytes to an UNSET fd (intending KEY_IMPORT), then calls KEY_GENERATE; ops->key_generate() returns an error. Call sequence: write(fd, secret, n) → ioctl(fd, KEY_GENERATE, ...) where key_generate fails. Bad outcome: the goto-out path (lines 1931-1932) does module_put(owner); goto out; without calling inbuf_clear(state). The sensitive write() bytes remain in state->inbuf until fd close, violating FIPS 140-3 key zeroization. A successful subsequent KEY_GENERATE on the same fd would also skip inbuf_clear — only the success path at line 1934 calls it.
